Fraudulent transfer of property in contemplation of bankruptcy, 18 U.S.C. § 152
Fraudulent transfer of property in contemplation of bankruptcy is a financial deception designed to avoid paying creditors.
Submitting false statements to Federal Housing Administration, 18 U.S.C. §§ 1010 and 2(b)
Submitting false statements to the Federal Housing Administration is a deceptive act for financial benefit.
Transporting firearm in foreign commerce, 18 U.S.C. § 922(g)(1); insubordination, Article 91, U.C.M.J.
Transporting firearm in foreign commerce and insubordination are unrelated to business or financial fraud.
Conspiracy to accept kickbacks on government contracts, 18 U.S.C. § 371 and 14 U.S.C. §§ 51 and 54
Conspiracy to accept kickbacks on government contracts is corporate fraud and public corruption.
Receiving and concealing stolen property, interstate transportation of stolen property, and bank robbery, 18 U.S.C. §§ 2314, 2315, and 2113(a) and (d)
Receiving/concealing stolen property and bank robbery are theft/violent property crimes, not white-collar.
